title: Z9.F infinite sum — Original even integer-quartic L identity
milestone_description: For every even integer $n\ge2$ and integer polynomial $W\in\mathbb Z[X]$ with degree at most4, cast its coefficients to $\mathbb Q$ and form the original actual p9,q1,m=n,d0 weighted rational function. The genuine sequence on positive natural arguments has HasSum to its exact $B+\rho_3\Re\zeta(3)+\rho_5\Re\zeta(5)+\rho_7\Re\zeta(7)+\rho_9\Re\zeta(9)$ linear form. The stronger degree bound is proved from the stated quartic/even-n domain. Integer W is not a claim that every rational local coefficient or full linear form is an integer. General parameters, inverse denominator heights, a small nonzero integer-form sequence, J and irrationality are separate obligations.
